annotation.title: NISAR L2 STATIC LAYERS Product
annotation.reference_document: D-102268 NASA SDS Product Specification for Level-2 Static Layers

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/missionId
string.annotation: Mission identifier

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/platformName
string.annotation: Name of the platform associated with the static layers included in this granule

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/instrumentName
string.annotation: Name of the instrument associated with the static layers included in this granule

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/radarBand
string.annotation: Frequency band associated with the static layers included in this granule, either "L" or "S"

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/processingCenter
string.annotation: Data processing center

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/processingType
string.annotation: Processing pipeline used to generate this granule. "Nominal": standard production system; "Custom": user-initiated processing outside the nominal production system

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/productType
string.annotation: Product type

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/granuleId
string.annotation: Unique granule identification name

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/productDoi
string.annotation: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for the product

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/productVersion
string.annotation: Product version which represents the structure of the product and the science content governed by the algorithm, input data, and processing parameters

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/productSpecificationVersion
string.annotation: Product specification version which represents the schema of this product

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/lookDirection
string.annotation: Look direction, either "Left" or "Right"

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/orbitPassDirection
string.annotation: Orbit direction, either "Ascending" or "Descending"

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/zeroDopplerStartTime
string.annotation: Azimuth start time (in UTC) of the product based on the time of the orbit state vectors used to generate the product, in the format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS.sssssssss

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/zeroDopplerEndTime
string.annotation: Azimuth stop time (in UTC) of the product based on the time of the orbit state vectors used to generate the product, in the format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS.sssssssss

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/productLevel
string.annotation: Product level. "L0A": Unprocessed instrument data; "L0B": Reformatted, unprocessed instrument data; "L1": Processed instrument data in radar coordinates system; and "L2": Processed instrument data in geocoded coordinates system

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/isGeocoded
string.annotation: Flag to indicate if the product data is in the radar geometry ("False") or in the map geometry ("True")

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/boundingPolygon
string.annotation: OGR compatible WKT representing the bounding polygon of the raster data. Horizontal coordinates are WGS84 longitude followed by latitude (both in degrees), and the vertical coordinate is the height above the WGS84 ellipsoid in meters. The first point corresponds to the the starting X and Y coordinate of the raster grid in the product's native coordinate system, and the perimeter is traversed in counterclockwise order on the ellipsoid. The polygon includes the four corners of the raster grid, with equal numbers of points distributed evenly in native coordinates of the product along each edge

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/processingDateTime
string.annotation: Processing date and time (in UTC) in the format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/validityStartDateTime
string.annotation: Starting date and time (in UTC) for when the parameters in this granule are valid for the NISAR data acquired, in the format YYYY-mm-ddTHH:MM:SS

string.name: /science/LSAR/identification/compositeReleaseId
string.annotation: Unique version identifier of the science data production system

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/digitalElevationModel
real.annotation: Topographic height above the reference ellipsoid, derived from the input Digital Elevation Model (DEM)

integer.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/layoverShadowMask
integer.annotation: Pixel-wise classification of layover and shadow, where 0 indicates a sample not affected by layover or shadow, 1 indicates a sample affected by shadow, 2 indicates a sample affected by layover, and 3 indicates a sample affected by both layover and shadow

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/localIncidenceAngle
real.annotation: Local incidence angle is defined as the angle between the target-to-platform line-of-sight vector and the terrain normal

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/losUnitVectorX
real.annotation: East component of the line-of-sight (LOS) unit vector, defined from the target to the sensor, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system with its origin at the target location

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/losUnitVectorY
real.annotation: North component of the line-of-sight (LOS) unit vector, defined from the target to the sensor, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system with its origin at the target location

integer.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/waterMask
integer.annotation: Binary mask where 1 indicates a water pixel (ocean or inland water) and 0 indicates a not-water pixel

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/rtcGammaToSigmaFactor
real.annotation: Radiometric terrain correction (RTC) scaling factor to normalize backscatter coefficients from gamma0 to sigma0, accounting for local terrain

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/rtcGammaToBetaFactor
real.annotation: Radiometric terrain correction (RTC) scaling factor to normalize backscatter coefficients from gamma0 to beta0, accounting for local terrain

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/yCoordinateSpacing
real.annotation: Nominal spacing in meters between consecutive lines

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/xCoordinateSpacing
real.annotation: Nominal spacing in meters between consecutive pixels

integer.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/projection

annotation.false_easting: The value added to all abscissa values in the rectangular coordinates for a map projection
annotation.false_northing: The value added to all ordinate values in the rectangular coordinates for a map projection
annotation.inverse_flattening: Inverse flattening of the ellipsoidal figure
annotation.latitude_of_projection_origin: The latitude chosen as the origin of rectangular coordinates for a map projection
annotation.longitude_of_projection_origin: The longitude, with respect to Greenwich, of the prime meridian associated with the geodetic datum
annotation.longitude_of_central_meridian: The line of longitude at the center of a map projection generally used as the basis for constructing the projection
annotation.scale_factor_at_central_meridian: A multiplier for reducing a distance obtained from a map by computation or scaling to the actual distance along the central meridian

integer.annotation: Product map grid projection: EPSG code, with additional projection information as HDF5 Attributes

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/xCoordinates
real.annotation: X coordinates in specified projection

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/grids/yCoordinates
real.annotation: Y coordinates in specified projection

string.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/orbit/interpMethod
string.annotation: Orbit interpolation method, either "Hermite" or "Legendre"

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/orbit/time
real.annotation: Time vector record. This record contains the time since UTC epoch corresponding to position and velocity records

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/orbit/position
real.annotation: Position vector record. This record contains the platform position data with respect to WGS84 G1762 reference frame

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/orbit/velocity
real.annotation: Velocity vector record. This record contains the platform velocity data with respect to WGS84 G1762 reference frame

string.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/orbit/orbitType
string.annotation: Orbit product type, either "FOE", "NOE", "MOE", "POE", or "Custom", where "FOE" stands for Forecast Orbit Ephemeris, "NOE" is Near real-time Orbit Ephemeris, "MOE" is Medium precision Orbit Ephemeris, and "POE" is Precise Orbit Ephemeris

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/attitude/time
real.annotation: Time vector record. This record contains the time since UTC epoch corresponding to attitude and quaternion records

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/attitude/quaternions
real.annotation: Attitude quaternions (q0, q1, q2, q3)

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/attitude/eulerAngles
real.annotation: Attitude Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw)

string.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/attitude/attitudeType
string.annotation: Attitude type, either "FRP", "NRP", "PRP, or "Custom", where "FRP" stands for Forecast Radar Pointing, "NRP" is Near Real-time Pointing, and "PRP" is Precise Radar Pointing

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/nativeDoppler/dopplerCentroid
real.annotation: 2D lookup table of Doppler centroid

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/nativeDoppler/slantRange
real.annotation: Slant range values corresponding to the native Doppler grid

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/nativeDoppler/zeroDopplerTime
real.annotation: Zero Doppler time since UTC epoch values corresponding to the native Doppler grid

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/radarGridParameters/slantRange
real.annotation: Slant range values corresponding to the slant range/azimuth grid used to form the layers in this granule related to radar collection geometry

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/radarGridParameters/slantRangeSpacing
real.annotation: Slant range spacing of the slant range/azimuth grid used to form the layers in this granule related to radar collection geometry. Same as difference between consecutive samples in slantRange array

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/radarGridParameters/zeroDopplerTime
real.annotation: Zero Doppler time since UTC epoch values corresponding to the slant range/azimuth grid used to form the layers in this granule related to radar collection geometry

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/radarGridParameters/zeroDopplerTimeSpacing
real.annotation: Time interval in the along-track direction for the slant range/azimuth grid used to form the layers in this granule related to radar collection geometry. This is same as the spacing between consecutive entries in the zeroDopplerTime array

real.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/radarGridParameters/centerFrequency
real.annotation: Center frequency of the slant range/azimuth grid used to form the layers in this granule related to radar collection geometry

string.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/processingInformation/softwareVersion
string.annotation: Software version used for processing

string.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/processingInformation/demSource
string.annotation: Description of the input digital elevation model (DEM)

string.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/processingInformation/waterMaskSource
string.annotation: Description of the input water mask

string.name: /science/LSAR/STATIC/metadata/processingInformation/runConfigurationContents
string.annotation: Contents of the run configuration file with parameters used for processing

shape.name: staticLayerLength
shape.annotation: Length dimension of the static layer datasets

shape.name: staticLayerWidth
shape.annotation: Width dimension of the static layer datasets

shape.name: staticLayerShape
shape.annotation: Shape associated with static layer datasets

shape.name: orbitShape
shape.annotation: Shape of orbit state vector triplets dataset

shape.name: attitudeShape
shape.annotation: Shape of attitude Euler angle triplets dataset

shape.name: nativeDopplerLength
shape.annotation: Length dimension of the native Doppler grid datasets

shape.name: nativeDopplerWidth
shape.annotation: Width dimension of the native Doppler grid datasets

shape.name: nativeDopplerShape
shape.annotation: Shape associated with native Doppler grid datasets

shape.name: radarGridParamsWidth
shape.annotation: Width dimension of the slant range/azimuth grid used to form the layers in this granule related to radar collection geometry

shape.name: radarGridParamsLength
shape.annotation: Length dimension of the slant range/azimuth grid used to form the layers in this granule related to radar collection geometry
